mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.1 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% in 1 month and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust housing market and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
